scenario: [LTIM.14.3]: a `calendar` call whose arguments all fold is a constant in every position, so one whose fold would raise [LTIM.14.2]'s fault is refused with DS_VALIDATE_CONST_NOT_FOLDABLE outside a `const` too. `calendar.date(2026, 2, 30)` names no day and stands in a rule's `where`. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate`'s `ltim_14_3_rule_expression`, which runs `ltim_14_3_raising_calls` over each of a rule's expressions.
rules_ds:
import calendar

schema T scope logical:
    id: Int key

rule r:
    T t where t.id == 1 and calendar.date(2026, 2, 30) != calendar.date(1970, 1, 1)
->
    log info "built"
